app.name: HarborGate
errors.notFound.title: Page not found
errors.notFound.body: This page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
rail.label: Main
scope.label: Scope
pagination.label: Pagination
admin.tabs.label: Admin
admin.settings.label: Settings sections
login.tagline: Image scan results, delivered to GitHub.
login.note: Admins can always sign in with a local password. Your administrator may limit other users to single sign-on.
login.error.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your username and password, or use single sign-on.
login.error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.error.sso: Single sign-on failed. Try again, or ask your administrator to check your group membership.
setup.intro: This page is only available until the first account exists. This account is a local admin and can always sign in, even after single sign-on is set up.
setup.passwordHelp: 15 to 64 characters. A passphrase works well.
setup.error.tooShort: The password must be at least 15 characters.
dashboard.subtitle: Open findings and the latest syncs across your mappings.
dashboard.noSyncs: No syncs yet. They appear here after the first scan result.
mappings.filter.label: Mapping
mappings.form.readOnly: This mapping belongs to another user. You can view it but not change it.
cves.subtitle: One row per CVE per mapping, for the newest image.
cves.detail.createIssueDisabled: An open issue already exists for this CVE
cves.detail.tagsNote: Open in {open} of {tracked} tags of the newest image. The issue closes when the newest image no longer reports it.
cves.accept.title: Accept risk for {cve}
cves.accept.body: Applies to every tag of {mapping}. No new issue is created while the acceptance is active.
cves.accept.issueNote: The open issue #{number} stays open and gets a comment with your name and reason.
cves.accept.expiresHelp: After this date the CVE counts again. Leave empty for no expiry.
cves.revoke.title: Revoke acceptance for {cve}
cves.revoke.body: The CVE counts again, and a new issue can be created for it.
cves.issue.failed: The issue could not be created.
cves.confirm.title: Create an issue for {cve}?
cves.confirm.body: This CVE is {severity} at its highest open severity. A GitHub issue is not created for it automatically. Create one anyway?
cves.createDialog.title: Create issue for {cve}
cves.createDialog.body: This creates a new issue in the GitHub repository below. Nothing is created until you confirm.
sources.subtitle: The registry images HarborGate scans, and where the results go.
sources.form.repositoryHelp: The path on the hub, for example nrosier/walley. No tag, no digest.
sources.form.repositoryInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and . _ - separators, with / between path parts. No : or @.
sources.form.tagHelp: An exact tag, or a pattern with * (any characters) and ? (one character).
sources.form.tagHintExact: Exact tag: only this tag is scanned.
sources.form.tagHintPattern: Pattern: every tag that matches is scanned.
sources.form.tagInvalid: Use an exact tag, or a pattern with only letters, digits, . _ - and the wildcards * and ?.
sources.form.credentialSet: A credential is saved for this source.
sources.form.noCredentialDockerHub: No credential is set. Docker Hub is pulled anonymously, which has a lower rate limit and cannot read private repositories.
sources.form.ghcrHint: ghcr.io accepts only a classic personal access token with read:packages.
sources.delete.title: Delete this source?
sources.delete.body: Its findings and registry credential are removed. GitHub issues stay open.
sources.scan.rateLimited: A scan was started recently. Try again in a few minutes.
sources.scan.failed: The registry could not be reached. Try again.
sources.images.title: Images
sources.images.empty: No images have been found yet.
syncJobs.subtitle: Every scan HarborGate received or polled, and what happened to it.
syncJobs.empty: No sync jobs match this filter.
syncJobs.purge.title: Purge failed jobs?
syncJobs.purge.body: This permanently deletes {count} failed sync jobs. CVE findings, reports, GitHub issues, and alerts are not changed.
syncJobs.purge.bodyOne: This permanently deletes 1 failed sync job. CVE findings, reports, GitHub issues, and alerts are not changed.
syncJobs.purge.countFailed: Could not load the number of failed jobs.
account.tabs.label: Account
account.intro: Your profile, sign-in, display preferences, and the credentials your mappings use.
account.profile.title: Profile
account.password.title: Password
account.password.help: Changing it signs you out on every other device.
account.password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions are signed out.
account.password.tooShort: The new password must be at least 15 characters.
account.signOutAll.title: Sign out everywhere
account.signOutAll.help: Ends every session for your account, including this one.
account.signOutAll.confirmBody: Every session for your account ends, including this one. You will need to sign in again.
account.appearance.title: Appearance
account.credentials.title: Credentials
account.credentials.help: GitHub tokens. Tokens are encrypted and never shown again after saving.
account.credentials.label: Label
account.credentials.deleteBody: The credential is removed. This cannot be undone.
account.credentials.inUse: This credential is used by a mapping. Change or delete the mapping first.
credentials.form.label: Label
credentials.form.labelHelp: A name you will recognise in the mapping form.
credentials.form.tokenHelp: Encrypted when saved. It is never shown again.
credentials.form.expiresHelp: HarborGate warns 14 days before this date.
credentials.test.title: Connection test
credentials.test.saved: Saved. HarborGate tested the credential from the server.
credentials.test.noRepository: The token cannot see any repository. Grant the token access to at least one repository.
credentials.test.unreachable: HarborGate could not reach the service.
admin.jobs.intro: Housekeeping runs: polling, cleanup and retention. Sync jobs have their own page.
admin.failed.intro: Failed sync jobs across all mappings. A retry queues the same job again.
admin.health.scan.title: Code scanning per GitHub target
admin.health.requestHelp: What HarborGate sees for this page load. Use it to check the trusted proxy setting.
admin.oidc.redirectHelp: Register this in your identity provider.
admin.oidc.secretSet: A secret is saved. It is never shown. Enter a new one only to replace it.
admin.oidc.secretPlaceholder: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
admin.oidc.rolesHelp: The role is read from this claim at every sign-in. A user in neither group cannot sign in.
admin.oidc.only: Single sign-on only for regular users
admin.oidc.onlyHelp: Regular users can no longer sign in with a local password. Admins can always sign in locally as a break-glass path.
admin.github.title: GitHub address
admin.github.help: Leave both fields empty to use github.com. Set them only for GitHub Enterprise Server or GHE.com.
admin.github.apiHelp: For example https://ghes.example.com/api/v3 or https://api.example.ghe.com. Empty means https://api.github.com.
admin.github.webHelp: The host only, for example https://ghes.example.com. Empty means https://github.com.
settings.github_url_invalid: Enter an https address with a host, for example https://ghes.example.com.
admin.users.title: Users
admin.users.help: Single sign-on users appear here after their first sign-in. Their role comes from the identity provider.
admin.users.lastAdmin: The last local admin cannot be demoted.
admin.users.deleteBody: The user and their data are removed. This cannot be undone.
admin.users.createHelp: For people who do not use single sign-on, and for break-glass admins.
admin.users.passwordHelp: 15 to 64 characters. Share it with the person securely.
admin.alerts.title: Alert channels
admin.alerts.help: Alerts go out when a sync fails or a new CRITICAL CVE appears, for every mapping. The same alert is sent at most once in 24 hours.
admin.alerts.formNote: Saved settings are encrypted and not shown. To change this channel, enter all its settings again.
admin.alerts.noPlain: Plain, unencrypted SMTP is not allowed.
admin.backup.title: Backup
admin.backup.help: Writes an encrypted copy of the database to the backup folder on the server. Only the same encryption key can restore it.
admin.backup.failed: The backup folder is missing or not writable.
admin.backup.keyNote: Keep your encryption key for as long as you keep backups made with it. After a key rotation, older backups still need the old key.
admin.restore.title: Restore
admin.restore.help: Restore runs from the command line with HarborGate stopped. It is not available in the browser.
admin.restore.run: Run the restore command with the same HARBORGATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY that made the backup:
admin.restore.start: Start HarborGate again. The audit log records the restore.
adminLog.title: Application log
adminLog.subtitle: Recent log lines from this HarborGate instance. Secrets are redacted before they are stored.
adminLog.level.label: Log level
adminLog.level.saveFailed: The log level could not be changed. Try again.
adminLog.debugBanner.title: Verbose logging is on.
adminLog.debugBanner.revertsAt: The level returns to info at {time} ({minutes} min).
adminLog.empty: No log lines match this filter.
adminLog.forbidden: You need an administrator account to view the application log.
mapping.picker.repositoryHint: Pick a project first. Repositories are shown without the project prefix; the saved value keeps it.
mapping.github.title: Pick a GitHub repository
mapping.github.orgNote: Only repositories this token can see are listed. Repositories of an organisation the token cannot reach do not appear; type the name in the form instead.
mapping.github.cut: This list was cut at 1,000 repositories and search cannot reach past the cut. Type the repository name in the form.
mapping.errors.rateLimit.message: A rate limit was reached. Try again later.
mapping.errors.rateLimit.note: Nothing is retried automatically. Try again when the wait is over.
mapping.errors.upstream.message: GitHub could not be reached. Try again.
mapping.errors.detail.githubToken: The GitHub token is not valid or cannot list repositories. Test it on the Account page.
mapping.errors.detail.wrongCredentialTyp: This credential is the wrong type for this list. Pick a credential of the right service.
sync.note.scanAlreadyRunning: A scan of this image is already running.
